manifest.purpose: Unchanged-production native baseline for catalog version resolution, true CTE bodies and retained SQLc role coverage.

contracts.counterfactual_scope: Only model.lgo is replaced by its exact pre-r40 bytes from 4bde2ec5; all other production and new permanent tests remain current. This proves added retained pipeline assertions; it is not an old full-source checkout.

manifest.native_contract_scope: 37 original statements and 37 actual SQLc-processed statements must produce their frozen native final values. PostgreSQL does not interpret plugin configuration; catalog-option validity is the explicit public Generate contract. Existing 20 role rows join the prior 40 permanent pipeline rows unchanged.

native_original.name: lower-option-lower-column
native_original.sql: UPDATE items SET version = version + 1;

native_original.name: mixed-option-lower-column
native_original.sql: UPDATE items SET version = version + 1;

native_original.name: upper-option-lower-column
native_original.sql: UPDATE items SET version = version + 1;

native_original.name: mixed-option-alias-refusal
native_original.sql: UPDATE items SET name = 'changed' RETURNING name AS version;

native_original.name: quoted-column-exact-option
native_original.sql: UPDATE items SET "Version" = "Version" + 1;

native_original.name: quoted-column-folded-option
native_original.sql: UPDATE items SET "Version" = "Version" + 1;

native_original.name: quoted-column-alias-refusal
native_original.sql: UPDATE items SET name = 'changed' RETURNING name AS "Version";

native_original.name: missing-configured-column
native_original.sql: SELECT id FROM items;

native_original.name: ambiguous-folded-option
native_original.sql: UPDATE items SET "Version" = "Version" + 1;

native_original.name: exact-option-before-fold-collision
native_original.sql: UPDATE items SET "Version" = "Version" + 1;

native_original.name: exact-option-rejects-quoted-sibling
native_original.sql: UPDATE items SET "VERSION" = "VERSION" + 1;

native_original.name: plain-cte-reference
native_original.sql: WITH bumped AS (UPDATE items SET version = version + 1 RETURNING id) SELECT id FROM bumped;

native_original.name: materialized-cte-reference
native_original.sql: WITH bumped AS MATERIALIZED (UPDATE items SET version = version + 1 RETURNING id) SELECT id FROM bumped;

native_original.name: not-materialized-cte-reference
native_original.sql: WITH bumped AS NOT MATERIALIZED (UPDATE items SET version = version + 1 RETURNING id) SELECT id FROM bumped;

native_original.name: plain-cte-omission
native_original.sql: WITH bumped AS (UPDATE items SET name = 'changed' RETURNING id) SELECT id FROM bumped;

native_original.name: materialized-cte-omission
native_original.sql: WITH bumped AS MATERIALIZED (UPDATE items SET name = 'changed' RETURNING id) SELECT id FROM bumped;

native_original.name: not-materialized-cte-omission
native_original.sql: WITH bumped AS NOT MATERIALIZED (UPDATE items SET name = 'changed' RETURNING id) SELECT id FROM bumped;

native_original.name: mixed-case-materialized-reference
native_original.sql: wItH bumped aS mAtErIaLiZeD (UPDATE items SET version = version + 1 RETURNING id) SELECT id FROM bumped;

native_original.name: column-list-materialized-reference
native_original.sql: WITH bumped(result_id) AS MATERIALIZED (UPDATE items SET version = version + 1 RETURNING id) SELECT result_id FROM bumped;

native_original.name: second-materialized-reference
native_original.sql: WITH seed AS (SELECT 1 AS value), bumped AS MATERIALIZED (UPDATE items SET version = version + 1 RETURNING id) SELECT id FROM bumped;

native_original.name: recursive-materialized-reference
native_original.sql: WITH RECURSIVE bumped AS MATERIALIZED (UPDATE items SET version = version + 1 RETURNING id) SELECT id FROM bumped;

native_original.name: quoted-cte-name-reference
native_original.sql: WITH "materialized" AS (UPDATE items SET version = version + 1 RETURNING id) SELECT id FROM "materialized";

native_original.name: main-alias-list-after-with
native_original.sql: WITH seed AS (SELECT 1 AS value) UPDATE items SET name = 'changed' FROM (VALUES (1)) AS materialized(version);

native_original.name: main-cast-after-with
native_original.sql: WITH seed AS (SELECT 1 AS value) UPDATE items SET name = CAST('changed' AS version);

native_original.name: main-alias-list-without-with
native_original.sql: UPDATE items SET name = 'changed' FROM (VALUES (1)) AS materialized(version);

native_original.name: materialized-cte-output-alias
native_original.sql: WITH bumped AS MATERIALIZED (UPDATE items SET name = 'changed' RETURNING id) SELECT id AS version FROM bumped;

native_original.name: ordinality-alias-list-omission
native_original.sql: UPDATE items SET name = 'changed' FROM unnest(ARRAY[1]) WITH ORDINALITY AS materialized(version, position) RETURNING items.id;

native_original.name: ordinality-cte-reference
native_original.sql: WITH ordinality AS MATERIALIZED (UPDATE items SET version = version + 1 RETURNING id) SELECT id FROM ordinality;

native_original.name: nested-materialized-cte-reference
native_original.sql: WITH a AS MATERIALIZED (WITH b AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT version FROM items) SELECT 1 FROM b) UPDATE items SET name = 'changed' WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM a);

native_original.name: search-sibling-reference
native_original.sql: WITH RECURSIVE walk(n,m) AS (SELECT 1,0 UNION ALL SELECT n+1,m FROM walk WHERE n<2) SEARCH DEPTH FIRST BY n,m SET visit_order, bumped AS MATERIALIZED (UPDATE items SET version=version+1 RETURNING id) SELECT id FROM bumped;

native_original.name: search-sibling-omission
native_original.sql: WITH RECURSIVE walk(n,m) AS (SELECT 1,0 UNION ALL SELECT n+1,m FROM walk WHERE n<2) SEARCH DEPTH FIRST BY n,m SET visit_order, bumped AS MATERIALIZED (UPDATE items SET name='changed' RETURNING id) SELECT id FROM bumped;

native_original.name: cycle-sibling-reference
native_original.sql: WITH RECURSIVE walk(n,m) AS (SELECT 1,0 UNION ALL SELECT n+1,m FROM walk WHERE n<2) CYCLE n,m SET cycle_hit USING cycle_path, bumped AS MATERIALIZED (UPDATE items SET version=version+1 RETURNING id) SELECT id FROM bumped;

native_original.name: cycle-sibling-omission
native_original.sql: WITH RECURSIVE walk(n,m) AS (SELECT 1,0 UNION ALL SELECT n+1,m FROM walk WHERE n<2) CYCLE n,m SET cycle_hit USING cycle_path, bumped AS MATERIALIZED (UPDATE items SET name='changed' RETURNING id) SELECT id FROM bumped;

native_original.name: search-cycle-sibling-reference
native_original.sql: WITH RECURSIVE walk(n,m) AS (SELECT 1,0 UNION ALL SELECT n+1,m FROM walk WHERE n<2) SEARCH DEPTH FIRST BY n,m SET visit_order CYCLE n,m SET cycle_hit USING cycle_path, bumped AS MATERIALIZED (UPDATE items SET version=version+1 RETURNING id) SELECT id FROM bumped;

native_original.name: search-cycle-sibling-omission
native_original.sql: WITH RECURSIVE walk(n,m) AS (SELECT 1,0 UNION ALL SELECT n+1,m FROM walk WHERE n<2) SEARCH DEPTH FIRST BY n,m SET visit_order CYCLE n,m SET cycle_hit USING cycle_path, bumped AS MATERIALIZED (UPDATE items SET name='changed' RETURNING id) SELECT id FROM bumped;

native_original.name: explicit-cycle-mark-sibling-reference
native_original.sql: WITH RECURSIVE walk(n,m) AS (SELECT 1,0 UNION ALL SELECT n+1,m FROM walk WHERE n<2) SEARCH BREADTH FIRST BY n,m SET visit_order CYCLE n,m SET cycle_hit TO 'Y' DEFAULT 'N' USING cycle_path, bumped AS MATERIALIZED (UPDATE items SET version=version+1 RETURNING id) SELECT id FROM bumped;

native_original.name: explicit-cycle-mark-sibling-omission
native_original.sql: WITH RECURSIVE walk(n,m) AS (SELECT 1,0 UNION ALL SELECT n+1,m FROM walk WHERE n<2) SEARCH BREADTH FIRST BY n,m SET visit_order CYCLE n,m SET cycle_hit TO 'Y' DEFAULT 'N' USING cycle_path, bumped AS MATERIALIZED (UPDATE items SET name='changed' RETURNING id) SELECT id FROM bumped;
